body.name: paired-splice soft-loss frontier handle
body.construction: Tensorize two-arm Hall splices across paired cells at an arbitrary admissible amplitude, retain the exact logarithmic mixture loss, condition on the pair sample counts, factor the product posterior, and compare every feasible zero/one/two-cell capacity allocation with one posterior-MAP action per pair by concavity. A binomial lower-tail calculation followed by amplitude optimization gives the multiscale same-class lower envelope. Comparing that envelope with the separate coordinatewise sorting-and-inversion upper witness closes the familywise phase \(\ell\min\{1,N^{-\varkappa}\}\geq[\log(2m)]^{1-\varkappa}\), including saturation. Below this elbow the construction supplies the lower expression with \([\ell\min\{1,N^{-\varkappa}\}]^{\varkappa/(1-\varkappa)}\), but no localized selected-mixture upper witness; equality of the two bounds is not part of the construction there.
